comment: Team deathmatch death as a seat (#510): a joined fighter stands on Larak Lot until a rule bot frags it, the death view shows the killer for a beat, then the camera rides the nearest living teammate's eyes. Run with FRAGR_QA_MODE=tdm FRAGR_QA_BOTS=7 FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/team_seat.json.

states.name: seat_joined
states.note: Joined fighter on the floor before the frag.

states.name: seat_killer_beat
states.note: The killer beat: the death view chases who did it, the card names them. Waits at the spawn for a frag, so no walk can spend the death before the wait begins.

states.name: seat_teammate
states.note: The seat: a living teammate's eyes, their gun, health and armour; the card sits low and names the F key.
